answer: A hostile operator running 140 aliases therefore needs 99 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in lantern, expire in oasis, and marble lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2399 identities would post 4848 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
